title: Green Valley Fertility Partners — Warning Letter (Biologics/CBER)
ai_summary: FDA Warning Letter 원문 기준, Green Valley Fertility Partners는 생식세포·조직 공여자의 WNV NAT 등 감염성 질환 시험과 위험요인 문진이 불완전한 상태에서 공여자 적격성을 판정했습니다. 시험·신체검사 완료 전 적격 판정, 동봉기록의 개인정보 노출, 공여자 식별코드 부적절로 기록 추적성과 QC 시험관리 및 QA 적격성 절차에 영향을 줍니다. 관련 HCT/P는 요건 미충족 시 사용·운송 전까지 격리 관리가 필요합니다.

change_summary: FDA Warning Letter 원문 기준, Green Valley Fertility Partners는 생식세포·조직 공여자의 WNV NAT 등 감염성 질환 시험과 위험요인 문진이 불완전한 상태에서 공여자 적격성을 판정했습니다. 시험·신체검사 완료 전 적격 판정, 동봉기록의 개인정보 노출, 공여자 식별코드 부적절로 기록 추적성과 QC 시험관리 및 QA 적격성 절차에 영향을 줍니다. 관련 HCT/P는 요건 미충족 시 사용·운송 전까지 격리 관리가 필요합니다.

impact_summary.value: FDA가 확인한 기증자 감염성 질환 검사·위험 선별·적격성 판정 및 기록 식별 관련 결함은 HCT/P 기증자 적격성 결정의 불완전성을 초래합니다. 선별·검사가 완료되지 않은 기증자의 보관 HCT/P는 격리해야 하며, 일부 격리 해제에는 FDA 승인 또는 규정에 따른 라벨링이 필요합니다.

evidence.quote: Please note that if you still have oocytes and/or semen in storage from donors whose screening and/or testing was not completed in accordance with 21 CFR Part 1271, FDA considers the donor eligibility determinations to be incomplete for these donors. For example, this includes donors who were not appropriately tested for relevant communicable disease agents and diseases and/or who were not appropriately screened for relevant communicable disease risk factors. Therefore, as required by 21 CFR 1271.60(a), you must keep these HCT/Ps in quarantine.
Before any of these HCT/Ps can be removed from quarantine, the request must be granted by FDA.

Therefore, as required by 21 CFR 1271.60(a), you must keep these HCT/Ps in quarantine. Should the need arise in the future to remove any of these HCT/Ps from quarantine, either for use in your own establishment or for transport to another establishment, you may release these HCT/Ps from quarantine (21 CFR 1271.90(b)) provided they are labeled in accordance with the applicable regulations at 21 CFR 1271.90(c).

affected_work.value: Green Valley Fertility Partners의 익명·지정 생식세포 기증자에 대한 WNV NAT 등 감염성 질환 검사, 감염 위험 선별, 기증자 적격성 판정, 동봉 기록의 개인정보 제외 및 HCT/P 용기의 고유 식별 코드 부여가 대상입니다. 관련 선별·검사가 미완료된 기증자의 보관 난자·정자·배아도 관련 대상입니다.

evidence.quote: Failure to test a specimen from an anonymous or directed reproductive donor of cells or tissue, whether viable or non-viable, for evidence of infection due to relevant communicable disease agents [21 CFR 1271.85(a)]. This includes testing for West Nile Virus (WNV) using an FDA-licensed Nucleic Acid Test (NAT) donor screening test for HCT/Ps recovered between June 1st and October 31st every year.
Failure to omit the donor’s name and other personal information on the accompanying records [21 CFR 1271.55(c)].

Failure to affix a distinct identification code to the HCT/P container, e.g., alphanumeric, that relates the HCT/P to the donor and all records pertaining to the HCT/P and, except in the case of autologous donations, directed reproductive donations, or donations made by first-degree blood relatives, does not include an individual’s name, social security number, or medical record number [21 CFR 1271.55(a)(1)].

recommendation.value: FDA는 지적된 위반을 신속히 시정하고 재발을 방지할 조치를 서면으로 회신하며, 시정이 완료되었음을 보여주는 자료를 포함하도록 요청했습니다. 기증자 선별·검사가 미완료된 보관 HCT/P는 격리하고, 격리 해제가 필요하면 해당 유형에 적용되는 FDA 승인 또는 규정상 라벨링 요건을 따르도록 명시했습니다.

evidence.quote: You should take prompt action to correct any violations addressed in this letter and prevent their recurrence. Failure to promptly correct any violations may result in regulatory action being initiated by FDA without further notice.

We request that you respond in writing within fifteen (15) working days from your receipt of this letter, outlining the specific steps you have taken or plan to take to correct any violations, including an explanation of how you plan to prevent them, or similar violations, from occurring again. Additionally, include any documentation necessary to show that correction has been achieved.

Therefore, as required by 21 CFR 1271.60(a), you must keep these HCT/Ps in quarantine. Should the need arise in the future to remove any of these HCT/Ps from quarantine, either for use in your own establishment or for transport to another establishment, you may release these HCT/Ps from quarantine (21 CFR 1271.90(b)) provided they are labeled in accordance with the applicable regulations at 21 CFR 1271.90(c).
